summary: Coordinate construction hazards, workface plans and site controls. Explore the five-day foundation course and its practical outputs.
lede: Construction industry safety training helps project managers, site supervisors and safety officers coordinate hazards and changing work across active sites. It develops practical skills in job safety analysis and selecting controls, building look-ahead plans around workface and contractor interfaces, and tracking permit checks, inspections and corrective actions in clear site records. Participants apply these methods to everyday construction tasks and prepare an integrated site action plan.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits people who coordinate construction work, check site conditions or connect safety controls with project delivery. It is designed for professionals who need practical methods for managing workfaces, contractors, inspections and site records.
modules: Construction Safety Duties and Site Records
Integrated Site Control and Project Reporting
prerequisites: Familiarity with construction project stages and common site activities is expected. No coding or programming is required.
